scope: Read-only saved NPZ/typed-trace comparison and timer-source inspection. No original geometry/images, model import, inference, projection, fitting, tests or scientific job.

worker_calendar.scope: Actual complete 40-row worker calendars, not general model speed. Startup, setup, output and scoring overhead included; external watchdog startup is separate.

old.rule: 1.5 * (measured model load + worst measured case calendar time * all eligible cases)

new.rule: 1.5 * (measured model load + worst measured case calendar time * all eligible cases)

timing_review.explanation: evaluate_case times the complete backend.infer return/exception; localize outer finally and immutable checks finish before that timer stops. Use outer inference_seconds, not raw internal elapsed_seconds.

caveats: Nominally the same local CPU and two-thread serial scientific execution; not randomized/interleaved repetitions or a controlled general hardware benchmark.
Cache reuse occurs within an inference. Both studies record40 fresh inferences and zero historical case-cache replays.
Eight unique image pairs at five checkpoints remain four unique positives/four negatives, not40 independent image-pair tests.
The worker calendar ratio does not establish a general model speedup, modern-model efficiency advantage, or localization/learning improvement.
The 1.5x worst-case projection still exceeds the original12000-second full-selection maximum; no automatic admission, deadline or budget reset follows.
